   3 | Two platform facts are handled here so the test measures the script and not
   4 | the shell it happens to land in: the interpreter is resolved with
   5 | ``shutil.which`` (the same lookup the harness uses, which finds the Git/MSYS

   9 | """

  12 | import subprocess
  13 | from pathlib import Path
  14 | 
  15 | REPO = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
  16 | SCRIPT = "tools/summarize.sh"
  17 | SAMPLES = "tools/samples"
  18 | BASH = shutil.which("bash") or "bash"
  19 | 
  20 | 
  21 | def run(args: list[str]) -> subprocess.CompletedProcess:
  22 |     return subprocess.run([BASH, SCRIPT, *args], cwd=REPO,
  23 |                           capture_output=True, text=True)
  24 | 
  25 | 
  26 | def test_one_line_per_file():
  27 |     done = run([SAMPLES])
